description.zh: Datawork Technology 开发的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。把本文件加成 Plugins → Discover 里的索引源即可浏览。

description.en: CyberOps red-team runtime: masked /cyber and authorized /cyber-2 routes whose tokens are unique per chat and re-minted on every activation, plus a composer Red Team toggle. Masking only happens while the chat is armed. Bring your own verified toolkit.
description.zh: CyberOps 红队运行时：掩码 /cyber 与授权的 /cyber-2 路由，令牌按会话唯一、每次激活重新生成，另有输入框 Red Team 开关。工具包需自备。
